notes: Design is not named; retrospective cohort is inferred from existing EHR records of treated patients followed 5–15 days. 'Weighted Charlson Comorbidity Index' is a comorbidity score, not survey weighting. No tests or CIs are reported.
view_issues: The Summary and Discussion suggest Paxlovid might prevent hospitalization, although the study has no untreated control group, as its own limitations acknowledge. The text calls the comorbidity index 'modified'; the table note calls it 'weighted'.
